journal_lines: §aCopper into iron into something neither. §oThe color changed before the smell did. Took it all.
§aFollowed the seam through three rock types. §oEach transition smelled different. Did not stop at any of them.
§aThe §lore§a changed kind twice in the same wall. Brought back samples of each.
§aStruck copper, then iron behind it, then a vein that had no name I knew. Still filled the bag.
§aOne seam running through three stones. §oThe rock itself smelled confused. I was not.
§aFound where the iron gave out and something older began. Took from both sides of the line.
§aThe wall did not want to give up the last of it. §oTook half a day. Worth it.
§aMixed seam, deep cut. Copper at the top, iron in the middle, something dark at the bottom. Carried all three home.
